rationale: Controller field-context, citing, writing-position and transfer suites retain the 105-case transaction/viewport gate.
Nine context-render raster tests retain original identity, generated-label exclusion, table clipping and mixed-direction coverage.
Direct-command and citing-dialog suites exercise callback lifecycle, cancellation, review, stale host state, focus restoration and immediate continued writing.
Existing full dialog, transfer dialog, document actions and dialog scaling suites cover regular workspace layout, existing library/refresh/review flows, import/export and bounded source scans.
Navigation, navigation-dialog, occurrence-navigation and selection-navigation suites distinguish explicit user navigation from temporary selected context and preserve source identity.
Note-target tests exercise body/Notes selection ownership, hidden marker offsets, composition and stale detached results.
Studio shortcuts, shortcut host ownership, citing transport and ODT export exercise application/route ownership, native-command dispatch, pending-work invalidation and persistence.
Strict analysis covers all changed editor and Studio production/test Dart paths relative to the initial main baseline; engine analysis and the new 21-case dialog gate have separate owners.
